Name: NPC Gift Stats
Author: HamBandit
Description:
[center]NPC Gift Stats is a mod that allows you to add items to NPC Gift lists.

Each NPC has a toggle for each list, and direct ability to edit their lists.
NPC's Can have the following Gift Lists edited:
- Loved
- Liked
- Neutral
- Disliked
- Hated

Additionally, items can be added or removed to the Universal Gift Lists.

Items not included in any list will not be part of the list, so simply delete default values to remove items from that list!
Mod defaults are vanilla defaults, so if you ever want to restore vanilla stats, simply hit "Default".

[b][i]THIS MOD BY DEFAULT MAKES NO CHANGES TO NPC GIFT TASTES!!![/i][/b]

------

This mod uses ItemIDs and CategoryIDs to add items to NPC Gift Lists!

To find ItemIDs of items, I recommend using a resource such as: [url=https://mateusaquino.github.io/stardewids/]Stardew IDs[/url]﻿﻿
(Big thanks to [url=https://github.com/MateusAquino/stardewids]MateusAquino[/url]﻿ for making this extremely useful website)

To find CategoryIDs, I recommend using the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Items#Categories]Stardew Valley Wiki[/url]﻿﻿﻿

------

This mod is adjustable with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
